Reply modes guide your model; they do not produce a normal reply to compare against. A matched run with Caveman off is needed to measure savings. No extra model requests are made for this report.
Shorter replies do not guarantee lower total cost. Style instructions also use input tokens.
Removes the optional skill pack and turns reply mode off. Chats and your own skill copies are kept. Instructions already loaded into a chat remain in its history.

Current workspace only. “Always” lasts until the active run ends. Revoking asks again when approval is required; it cannot stop an action already approved. Full auto and Full access can still bypass these prompts.
Grant root access once after each app start to reconnect. Turning this back on restores the per-use limits.
Project permissions are unused while temporary root mode is off.
Allow the agent to request root in selected projects. Full access mode does not override this choice.
Temporary root mode limits root to one app session, one chat or one action, and to projects you allow.
Turning it off lets the agent use root in every project and chat for as long as the root connection is active. Project permissions and per-use limits no longer apply.
Only turn this off on a device you fully control. You still grant root explicitly once after each app start.
Your changes to this root file have not been saved.
Password-encrypted API providers, preferences, and saved memories, with optional API keys and MCP configuration. Local models are excluded. Chats have a separate backup.
MCP commands, URLs and headers can contain secrets, so MCP servers are included only with credentials. OAuth sessions, permissions, app lock and workspace access are never restored.
Encrypted settings exported. Keep the password separately.

Providers are added as new connections, not overwritten. Preferences and selected models will change. Memories are added without overwriting existing ones; project memories from missing workspaces become global. Existing app lock, screenshot policy and permissions stay unchanged. MCP servers are added disabled; review them before enabling.
Only restore a backup you trust. Imported provider endpoints can receive future messages. Restoring does not contact them.
Missing search and voice keys are restored when included. Existing keys are kept. GitHub tokens and OAuth sessions are excluded.
Settings restored. Review new connections before use.
Restore did not finish. Stop active tasks and check connections before retrying; some entries may have been added.
